supplement.heading: 6.3 Detection Results for Five Pathogens
paragraphs: We performed sensitivity and specificity tests for the HI, BP, SPN, RSV, and hMPV assays using ByeGerm 2.0 (Figure 6.3, A–E). In each panel, the left image shows the sensitivity test: all three test tubes containing extracts of the corresponding pathogen showed green fluorescence and positive results in the app. The right image shows the specificity test: all three test tubes containing extracts of other pathogens gave negative results. In each image, the first two tubes were positive and negative controls, followed by three test tubes. All controls gave the expected results.

We also tested result recognition across five tube positions. The app correctly identified both alternating arrangements of positive and negative controls. Five test tubes placed in the order HI, BP, SPN, RSV, and hMPV all gave positive results (Figure 6.3, F). These tests show that the device can read fluorescence signals from the five assays and display a separate result for each tube in the app.
supplement.caption: Figure 6.3. Sensitivity, specificity, and five-tube detection results. A–E: HI, BP, SPN, RSV, and hMPV, respectively. Left: sensitivity tests with extracts of the corresponding pathogen. Right: specificity tests with extracts of other pathogens. In each image, the first two tubes are positive and negative controls, followed by three test tubes. F: the left and middle images show five alternating positive/negative control pairs in total; the right image shows results for HI, BP, SPN, RSV, and hMPV test tubes, in that order.

source_issues: Primary prose / editable specifications identify Raspberry Pi in generation 1; reproduction guide system table identifies Orange Pi 5 Max / RK3588 and later repeats Raspberry Pi. No silent substitution.
Generation-2 Figure 20 caption describes STM32 AI vision control; reproduction guide and BOM separate RK3588 image processing from STM32F407ZGT6 peripheral control.
The provided generation-2 user manual cover repeats 7.5 x 14 x 11 cm, while the hardware draft and reproduction guide give 15 x 30 x 20 cm. Original PDF is unchanged.
Primary paragraph describes 802.11ac and later Wi-Fi 6E; no exact installed wireless variant or raw latency/thermal test records supplied.
Hardware draft refers fluorescence CNN training to Model; current Model page covers primer-crRNA ranking and reaction kinetics. Cross-module clarification belongs to 00.

October 14 supplement supplies the qualitative five-pathogen results and six panels. Its comment notes no concentration series, no diagnostic sensitivity/specificity percentages, unspecified hMPV subtype and non-target identities, and five separate assay tubes rather than single-tube multiplexing.
Raw CAD, Gerber, firmware, model weights and itemized procurement evidence are not present; reproduction guides describe fabrication but are not source-design downloads.
qPCR procurement example has no procurement URL in the supplied materials; retained as a source comparison, not an independently verified current market price.
Protocol and Software resource placement and final cross-module manual versions are for 00; Hardware opens its supplied PDFs directly.
